Today: 2026-11-23
Tallis Press - editorial and production weekly, Monday 23 November 2026. Lead title this week: the second edition of A Field Guide to Coastal Birds (author Margaret Ellwood), which is the project this report is written for; the rest of the list is summarised below.

Coastal Birds, 2nd edition - recap
The new edition adds 46 species, replaces 210 of the illustrations with new paintings by Tom Hearne, and updates every range map with the latest survey data. The publication date announced to booksellers is February 3, 2027, timed for the spring birding season; our distributor needs finished copies in its warehouse three weeks before that, by January 13.

Editorial
Copyedits were returned by Margaret on November 6 with fewer queries than expected. The index has been compiled and checked against second proofs. The foreword by the ornithologist Dr Priya Nandakumar arrived on November 10 and needed only light edits.

Production and printing
Tom delivered the last 18 paintings on November 13, a week later than his contract date, which we had expected because he was ill in October. The design team absorbed the delay by laying out the plates as they arrived rather than in a single batch. Colour proofs came back from the printer on November 19, and Margaret and Tom approved them on November 20 with corrections on only four plates. Print-ready files go to the printer on November 30. The printer has confirmed its press slot for December 7 and binding the following week; with shipping, finished copies reach the distributor's warehouse on January 6, a week before the January 13 deadline, which keeps the February 3 publication intact.

Marketing
Advance reading copies went to 60 reviewers and 25 bird-observatory shops. The publicity team has booked Margaret for two radio interviews in February and a talk at the national birdwatching fair. Pre-orders are 18 percent ahead of the first edition at the same point.

Rest of the list
- The Salt Road (memoir, J. Aldous): publication moved from January to April because the author is rewriting the final chapter; the editor is working through the earlier chapters meanwhile.
- Children's atlas series: cancelled after the co-edition partner in Germany withdrew; the two titles already published stay in print.
- Gardening with Shade (reprint): waiting on the rights holder of the photographs to confirm the reprint licence; the printer cannot start until it is signed.
- Winter poetry anthology: published on November 12 and selling steadily.

Rights and contracts
The Dutch publisher has made an offer for translation rights to Coastal Birds; the rights team will negotiate after the English edition is out. The audiobook option for The Salt Road has been extended.

Operations
The new title-management system went live on November 16; please report duplicate ISBN records to Gwen. The warehouse stocktake is on December 3, so no returns will be processed that day.

People
Welcome to Ruth Adeyemi, assistant editor on the non-fiction list. Ian is on leave December 14 to January 4.

Next week
Production sends Coastal Birds files on Monday 30th; marketing finalises the bookshop point-of-sale materials; the editorial meeting will review the spring catalogue copy.

options.B: 專案進度落後，交付日期延後，無法依原定時程完成。
options.C: 專案遭遇阻礙，工作卡關，需要先排除問題才能繼續。
